title: Java Fundamentals
description: Test core Java syntax, object-oriented programming, collections, and exception handling.

questions.questionText: Which keyword creates a subclass in Java?
questions.solution: A class uses the extends keyword to inherit from another class.

questions.questionText: Which collection does not allow duplicate elements?
questions.solution: Set implementations enforce uniqueness and therefore do not contain duplicate elements.

questions.questionText: What is the default value of an instance boolean field?
questions.solution: An instance boolean field is initialized to false when no explicit value is supplied.

questions.questionText: Which block always runs after try unless the JVM terminates?
questions.solution: The finally block is intended for cleanup and normally executes whether an exception occurs or not.

questions.questionText: Which access modifier restricts a member to its declaring class?
questions.solution: A private member is accessible only within the class that declares it.
